/**
 * Returns a new array with all elements except for the first.
 *
 * This function takes an array and returns a new array containing all the elements
 * except for the first one. If the input array is empty or has only one element,
 * an empty array is returned.
 *
 * @template T - The type of elements in the array.
 * @param arr - The array to get the tail of.
 * @returns A new array containing all elements of the input array except for the first one.
 *
 * @example
 * const arr1 = [1, 2, 3];
 * const result = tail(arr1);
 * // result will be [2, 3]
 *
 * const arr2 = [1];
 * const result2 = tail(arr2);
 * // result2 will be []
 *
 * const arr3 = [];
 * const result3 = tail(arr3);
 * // result3 will be []
 */

contract.method: source-reviewed curated specification; not automatic extraction
contract.description: Return a new array containing all input elements except the first, preserving order and duplicates. Empty and single-element inputs produce an empty array.
contract.domain: The input is a dense array of at most 128 finite numbers, each between -1000 and 1000. The input must not be modified. Return a fresh array even when its contents are unchanged.
contract.outputRole: fresh sequence without the first element
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
